goal: Allow external mining clients to submit and prioritize a mined block over competing tips in one IPC call
Eliminate round trips and race conditions with concurrent chain activations from separate RPC calls
reviewability: Worth reviewing now because the logic is ready
Needs a mechanical rebase due to conflicts with master
agreement: Broad support for letting miners atomically prioritize their own blocks (Sjors, pablomartin4btc, enirox001)
Concept support noting that preferring own tips rationally maximizes mining rewards (johnnyasantoss, 0xB10C)
Unanswered question asks if downstream client demand justifies IPC compatibility costs (enirox001)
Unaddressed suggestion to combine duplicate inconclusive-result checks (enirox001)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it allows IPC miners to atomically prioritize their own blocks over competing equal-work tips
Removes round-trip latency and prevents race conditions with concurrent chain activations
